answer: A network that pays per identity must price identity itself. Proof-of-work activation: a new key must solve a puzzle bound to the epoch seed, about 40 seconds of CPU per identity. A farm of 860 fakes pays 573 CPU-minutes every epoch, while one honest agent pays once. A farm that precomputes puzzles wastes the work when the seed rotates. The gale of the design is public, the jade of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the umber of honest work is what finally pays. That is the whole defence: make the fake cost more than the real.
